icons.name: support-agent
icons.heading: Support agent
icons.description: A call comes in and the agent takes it. Light: the caller's voice arrives as an arc at each ear cup, travelling in and fading as it lands, and the agent nods once in answer, rebounds and settles. Strong: two calls of voice arrive in turn and the agent nods twice, the second deeper, with the boom mic swinging on its hinge a beat behind. The shoulders never move.

icons.name: help-center
icons.heading: Help center
icons.description: Help is thrown in. Light: the lifebuoy is tossed up spinning a whole turn, splashes down, bobs once and settles; a ripple draws out on each side of it at the waterline as it lands and fades. Strong: a wind-up, a higher toss, a deeper splash with two bobs, and the ripples spread wider. The end pose is the rest pose.

icons.name: support-ticket
icons.heading: Support ticket
icons.description: The ticket is torn off. Light: the stub peels away from the top of the seam, a fleck flying off there, strains a beat, then the bottom gives with a second fleck and the stub jerks free to the right, swings past its tilt and settles torn away, where it stays. Strong: a deeper peel that strains twice, a harder rip that overshoots further and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared ticket.
